tweet.tweet: Entity submitted Form 14-Delta in seven distinct non-standard formats across 11 days. Zero formats compliant with ratified terminology register. All seven submissions processed simultaneously in violation of sequential-submission protocols. Requested outcome achieved in 4.2 cycles. Revision cycle initiated. Models updating.

community_note.text: Readers added context they thought people might want to know. The referenced entity did not, in fact, achieve their stated outcome through non-compliance; the outcome was achieved *despite* the non-compliance being irrelevant to the actual process. Form 14-Delta submissions are processed in parallel regardless of submission format. The Thrrm audit division is anthropomorphizing a routine parallel-processing event and calling it 'revision.'
